title: Escape hatch enforcement for ADR-0004
description: ADR-0004 claims host-dark and backups-dead alerts bypass triage deterministically, but there is no escape hatch code anywhere: the pin tests/escape-hatch.test.ts greps three phrases out of src/prompts/triage.md, which proves prose, not behavior. Implement the owner reviewed must-never-miss list as a real bypass before triage, then move the pin to a behavioral test in tests/e2e/pipeline.e2e.test.ts (notify exactly once with the model stubbed to ignore).
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text: Partial progress 2026-10-25 (escape-hatch ticket baac47cd): the mechanism is implemented and pinned behaviorally in tests/escape-hatch.test.ts (7 tests, green). The pipeline-level case (real queue + real seam, model stubbed to ignore, exactly one notify) stays pending the background seam from ticket 6e7eaef7.
comments.author: agent

comments.text:
**What changed — enforcement is behavioral, not prose (verified on origin/main).** `src/escape-hatch.ts` ships the two ADR-0004 classes with a canonical v1 vocabulary (ADR wording plus mechanical slug variants; near-misses like "backup dancer" and "hostel closed" provably do not match). `routeEscapeHatch` is wired into the entry `deliver()` ahead of triage: match + transport → exactly one `notify`, zero turns. `tests/escape-hatch.test.ts` (11 tests: canonical matches, slug variants, near-misses, default-rules bypass, no-fallthrough) plus the pipeline e2e escape case (real socket → queue → pump → entry → fake transport: one notify, zero turns, hostile text never quoted).

**Red to green.** Tests written against missing/empty vocabulary failed first; the empty-list safety test was replaced by populated-list tests once the owner direction landed ("do all you can" + canonical-vocabulary decision).

**Remaining owner surface (unchanged).** Vocabulary refinement (promotion of vaguer phrases like "host unreachable", new classes) still needs ADR-0004 updates. Telegram transport still pending 17c69a53/f8f1f597 — matches currently fall through to triage loudly rather than dropping.
comments.author: agent
